heaps/01_heapify_by_hand.algorithm:
sift_down(heap, i, n):
    loop:
        left = 2i + 1, right = 2i + 2, smallest = i
        if left < n and heap[left] < heap[smallest]: smallest = left
        if right < n and heap[right] < heap[smallest]: smallest = right   (compare with the smaller candidate)
        if smallest == i: stop
        swap heap[i] and heap[smallest]
        i = smallest
heapify(nums):
    heap = copy of nums, n = its length
    for i from n//2 - 1 down to 0:   (the last parent first, the root last)
        sift_down(heap, i, n)
    return heap

heaps/02_push_and_pop_by_hand.algorithm:
heap_push(heap, value):
    append value, i = last index
    while i > 0:
        parent = (i - 1) // 2
        if heap[parent] <= heap[i]: stop   (float up only while the parent is bigger)
        swap heap[i] and heap[parent]
        i = parent
heap_pop(heap):
    top = heap[0], last = remove the final element
    if heap is now empty: return top
    heap[0] = last, i = 0, n = length
    loop:
        child = 2i + 1
        if child + 1 < n and heap[child + 1] < heap[child]: child = child + 1   (the smaller child)
        if child >= n or heap[i] <= heap[child]: stop
        swap heap[i] and heap[child]
        i = child
    return top

heaps/04_max_heap_by_negation_and_tuples.algorithm:
max_push(heap, value):
    push -value   (the smallest negative is the largest original)
max_pop(heap):
    return -(pop the smallest)
pop_in_priority_order(tasks):
    heap = empty min-heap, arrival = 0
    for each (priority, payload) in tasks:
        push (-priority, arrival, payload)   (arrival breaks ties, so payloads never compare)
        arrival = arrival + 1
    order = empty list
    while heap is not empty:
        (neg_priority, arrival, payload) = pop the smallest
        append payload to order
    return order

tries/02_trie_delete.algorithm:
insert(root, word):
    node = root
    for each ch in word:
        if ch not a child of node: add a new child for ch
        node = that child
    mark node as a word end
build_trie(words):
    root = new node, insert every word, return root
delete(root, word):
    path = [root], node = root
    for each ch in word:
        if ch not a child of node: return false   (the word is not in the trie)
        node = that child, append node to path
    if node is not a word end: return false
    clear the end flag of node
    for i from last index of word down to 0:
        parent = path[i], child = path[i + 1]
        if child has children or ends a word: stop   (another word still needs it)
        remove word[i] from parent's children
    return true

tries/03_autocomplete_collect_words_with.algorithm:
insert(root, word):
    node = root
    for each ch in word:
        if ch not a child of node: add a new child for ch
        node = that child
    mark node as a word end
build_trie(words):
    root = new node, insert every word, return root
collect(node, word_so_far, out):
    if node ends a word: append word_so_far to out
    for each ch in node's children in sorted order:   (sorted children give sorted output)
        collect(child for ch, word_so_far + ch, out)
words_with_prefix(root, prefix):
    node = root
    for each ch in prefix:
        if ch not a child of node: return empty list
        node = that child
    out = empty list
    collect(node, prefix, out)
    return out

backtracking/02_subsets_with_duplicates.algorithm:
backtrack(nums, start, path, res):
    append a copy of path to res
    for i from start to last index:
        if i > start and nums[i] == nums[i - 1]: skip   (only the first of equal values on a level)
        append nums[i] to path
        backtrack(nums, i + 1, path, res)
        remove the last element of path
subsets_with_duplicates(nums):
    nums = sorted nums
    res = empty list
    backtrack(nums, 0, empty path, res)
    return res sorted

backtracking/03_combinations_n_choose_k.algorithm:
backtrack(n, k, start, path, res):
    if path has k numbers: append a copy to res, return
    for i from start to n:
        if n - i + 1 < k - length of path: stop   (too few numbers left to fill the open slots)
        append i to path
        backtrack(n, k, i + 1, path, res)
        remove the last element of path
combinations(n, k):
    res = empty list
    backtrack(n, k, 1, empty path, res)
    return res sorted

backtracking/06_permutations_with_duplic.algorithm:
backtrack(nums, used, path, res):
    if path is as long as nums: append a copy to res, return
    for each index i:
        if used[i]: skip
        if i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i - 1] and not used[i - 1]: skip   (equal values left to right)
        used[i] = true, append nums[i] to path
        backtrack(nums, used, path, res)
        remove the last element of path, used[i] = false
permutations_with_duplicates(nums):
    nums = sorted nums
    used = all false
    res = empty list
    backtrack(nums, used, empty path, res)
    return res sorted

bits/01_get_set_clear_toggle_bits.algorithm:
get_bit(n, i):
    return (n >> i) & 1
set_bit(n, i):
    mask = 1 << i
    return n | mask
clear_bit(n, i):
    mask = 1 << i
    return n & ~mask   (~mask is 0 at position i and 1 everywhere else)
toggle_bit(n, i):
    mask = 1 << i
    return n ^ mask
update_bit(n, i, v):
    cleared = clear_bit(n, i)
    return cleared | (v << i)

bits/02_count_bits_and_lowest_set_bit.algorithm:
count_bits(n):
    count = 0
    while n != 0:
        n = n & (n - 1)   (one set bit disappears per round)
        count = count + 1
    return count
lowest_set_bit(n):
    return n & -n
is_power_of_two(n):
    if n <= 0: return false
    return n & (n - 1) == 0

bits/03_xor_tricks_single_number_missing.algorithm:
single_number(nums):
    acc = 0
    for each x in nums: acc = acc ^ x
    return acc
missing_number(nums):
    acc = n   (index n has no element to pair with)
    for each index i: acc = acc ^ i ^ nums[i]
    return acc
two_single_numbers(nums):
    both = XOR of all nums   (pairs cancel: both == a ^ b)
    diff = both & -both   (lowest set bit: set in exactly one of a, b)
    first = 0
    for each x in nums:
        if x & diff != 0: first = first ^ x
    second = both ^ first
    return [first, second] sorted

bits/04_bitmask_subset_enumeration.algorithm:
subsets_by_bitmask(items):
    n = length of items, out = empty list
    for mask from 0 to 2^n - 1:
        chosen = empty list
        for i from 0 to n - 1:
            if (mask >> i) & 1: append items[i] to chosen   (bit i says items[i] is in)
        append chosen to out
    return out
submasks(mask):
    out = empty list, sub = mask
    while sub != 0:
        append sub to out
        sub = (sub - 1) & mask   (the & keeps the borrow inside the mask's bits)
    append 0 to out
    return out

bits/05_reverse_bits_and_shifts.algorithm:
reverse_bits(n):
    result = 0
    repeat 32 times:   (leading zeros count too, so always 32 rounds)
        bit = n & 1
        result = (result << 1) | bit
        n = n >> 1
    return result
logical_right_shift(n, k):
    unsigned = n & 0xFFFFFFFF   (the 32-bit pattern as a positive number)
    return unsigned >> k
